map.成本管理（S曲线/挣值管理 EVM） 使用指南: Cost Management (S-curve / Earned Value Management EVM) User Guide
map.输入各周期的计划值(PV)、挣值(EV)、实际成本(AC)，自动计算挣值管理指标: Enter planned value (PV), earned value (EV) and actual cost (AC) for each period to automatically compute earned value management metrics and generate the S-curve.
map.项目例行性成本与进度联合监控：工程、IT 或研发项目按月填报各期计划值 PV、挣: Routine joint cost and schedule monitoring for projects: engineering, IT or R&D projects fill in planned value PV, earned value EV and actual cost AC each month, use CV/SV/CPI/SPI to judge whether the problem is cost overrun or schedule lag, and trigger correction promptly for projects with CPI or SPI below 0.9.
map.里程碑汇报与 S 曲线评审：把各期累计 PV、EV、AC 绘制成 S 曲线，向甲: Milestone reporting and S-curve review: plot cumulative PV, EV and AC per period as an S-curve and show management or the client the three-line 'plan vs actual vs earned value' variance, supporting change approval and progress payment decisions.
map.完工预测（EAC/ETC/VAC）：当中途发现 CPI 持续偏低，用典型偏差法: Completion forecasting (EAC/ETC/VAC): when CPI is found persistently low midway, use the typical-variance EAC = BAC/CPI to forecast total project cost, estimate whether the budget will be exceeded, how much more is needed and the completion variance, supporting executive decisions.
map.算例：BAC 150 万、计划 100 天、3 期累计: Worked example: BAC 1,500,000, planned 100 days, 3 periods cumulative
map.：输入：BAC=1,500,000 元、计划总工期 100 天；3 期数据 PV: : input: BAC = 1,500,000 CNY, planned total duration 100 days; 3 periods with PV = 300,000/450,000/450,000, EV = 280,000/420,000/400,000, AC = 320,000/470,000/460,000 (unit: CNY). Cumulative PV = 1,200,000, EV = 1,100,000, AC = 1,250,000. CV = EV − AC = −150,000 CNY (cost overrun); SV = EV − PV = −100,000 CNY (schedule lag); CPI = EV/AC = 0.88 (low cost efficiency); SPI = EV/PV = 0.92 (low schedule efficiency); EAC = BAC/CPI = 1,704,545 CNY (budget 1,500,000, so 204,545 over); ETC = EAC − AC = 454,545 CNY; VAC = BAC − EAC = −204,545 CNY; earned value completion EV/BAC = 73.3%; by SPI the forecast total duration is about 109 days (planned 100 days). Conclusion: both cost and schedule are low, so priority goes to crashing to recover SPI and analyzing the root cause of the AC overrun.
map.CPI 和 SPI 都小于 1，项目还有救吗？应该怎么解读？: Both CPI and SPI are below 1 - is the project still recoverable? How should this be read?
map.CPI<1 表示单位成本挣到的价值低于实际花费（超支），SPI<1 表示实际进度: CPI below 1 means the value earned per unit cost is less than what was actually spent (over budget); SPI below 1 means actual progress lags the plan. Both below 1 means the project is 'both over budget and behind schedule'. Generally CPI is less reversible than SPI - money spent is hard to recover, while schedule can be partly recouped by crashing or adding resources. As a rule of thumb, CPI or SPI below 0.9 triggers correction: first check whether the AC overrun comes from unit price increases or runaway work quantities, then check whether low EV is an efficiency problem or scope change not yet booked.
map.EAC 的几种算法（典型偏差 / 非典型偏差）怎么选？: How do I choose among the EAC formulas (typical variance / atypical variance)?
map.典型偏差法 EAC=BAC/CPI 假设当前成本绩效会延续到完工，用于「趋势不会: The typical-variance method EAC = BAC/CPI assumes current cost performance continues to completion and is used when 'the trend will not improve on its own'; this tool uses it. The atypical-variance method EAC = AC + (BAC − EV) assumes remaining work runs on budget and is used when 'the root cause has been found and fixed and the rest returns to plan'. The choice depends on whether there is reliable evidence that the variance will not continue: use atypical variance only when corrective action is in place and verifiable, otherwise typical variance is the more conservative choice.
